description: This file defines utilities and logic related to managing and checking the environment for the 'gateway' component in the OpenClaw project. It includes version parsing, environment status checks, command resolution, and installation routines for the gateway application and its dependencies.

classes.name: Semver
classes.description: A helper struct to handle semantic versioning (major.minor.patch) comparisons and parsing.

classes.name: GatewayEnvironmentKind
classes.description: An enum distinguishing different environment states of the gateway, such as checking, ok, missing components, or errors.

classes.name: GatewayEnvironmentStatus
classes.description: A struct representing the current environmental status of the gateway, including version info and status message.

classes.name: GatewayCommandResolution
classes.description: A struct representing the result of attempting to resolve or prepare the gateway command, including status and command arguments.

methods.name: gatewayPort
methods.description: Returns the configured port for the gateway, checking environment variables, config files, and defaults.

methods.name: expectedGatewayVersion
methods.description: Returns the expected gateway version as a Semver object based on bundle information.

methods.name: check
methods.description: Performs a comprehensive environment check for the gateway, returning the environment status.

methods.name: resolveGatewayCommand
methods.description: Resolves and constructs the command line to start the gateway based on environment and configuration.

methods.name: installGlobal
methods.description: Installs or updates the global gateway implementation asynchronously, providing status updates.
